progressionRule: Start below your previous capacity. After comfortable, symptom-free sessions, add a few repetitions or 1–2 minutes of walking before considering a small load increase. Reduce volume, range or pace as pregnancy changes; never progress automatically by gestational week.
deloadRule: Use an easier week whenever fatigue, discomfort or recovery changes. Halve sets or shorten walks; omit any exercise that does not feel right. Stop for warning symptoms and contact your maternity team.
whyThisWorks: Guidelines support a mixture of aerobic and resistance activity in uncomplicated pregnancy when contraindications are absent. These conservative templates use upright, supported movements and symptom-led adjustment; the exact plans have not been tested as clinical interventions.
volumeNotes: Work gradually toward the pregnancy guideline of at least 150 minutes of moderate activity over at least three days, with activity on other days as comfortable. These strength sessions are only part of that weekly total; the target is not a starting dose.
